mira: small but mighty update  we officially hit 20M ARR today and crossed 1B inference requests this year :tada: :cactus:
devon: wait what 1 BILLION requests?? holy moly :exploding_head: congrats team
zara: this is huge. everyone did the thing 49b
omar: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheers-llm-1b-zoom :party_parrot:
ops-bot: milestone recorded -> type=arr amount=20000000 requests=1000000000 id=m-1989012345
faye: celebration idea: bubble tea bar in kitchen at 4pm, tiny trophy cookies, and a baby cactus adoption table (they come with care cards)
mira: love that. remote folks: we can mail a mini cactus-care postcard + sticker if you opt in
devon: poll: danger level for confetti pop? (1) full confetti (2) biodegradable micro-confetti (3) no confetti
zara: 2
omar: 2
faye: 1
mira: 2
devon: tally: 3 for biodegradable micro-confetti -> approved :drum:
nora: i can coordinate shipping for remote cactuses and postcards. will share a sign-up form in 10m
ops-bot: calendar: kitchen reserved 16:00-16:30 by mira. Event created.
mira: logistics: setup crew meet 15:40. volunteers: faye (bubble-tea syrups), zara (trophy cookies + labeling), omar (photo & polaroids), devon (1-slide brag for execs)
devon: headline options: "One Billion Token Toss" or "20M ARR: We Grew Up a Little"
zara: love the first but keep it silly. also can we have a tiny bell for the cactus adoptions? :bell:
ops-bot: reminder: follow office plant policy for on-site adoptions. mailing list will require opt-in and address confirmation
faye: packaging note: cactuses will be 2-3cm pots. care card will include watering cadence and sunlight guide. low-maintenance champions
mira: remote folks: we'll stream the bell-ringing + bubble-tea cheers on #random-video-call at 16:10 for 2 minutes. please do not feel pressured to attend if heads down
omar: photo caption idea: "1B Requests, 20M ARR, 1 Tiny Cactus"
zara: vote: cactus name for the lobby? (1) Spike (2) Prickles (3) Ficus (kidding)
ops-bot: tally: Spike=3, Prickles=2 -> Spike it is
mira: quick shoutout: infra for keeping the tail latencies low, models for the compression wins, and CS for the customer hand-holding. so proud of everyone :heart: :confetti_ball:
devon: can we get a quick sticker sheet to celebrate this quarter? i will design and drop in the kitchen by noon
nora: shipping form: https://forms.gle/cactus-mailer-1989 (placeholder)
ops-bot: note: kitchen cleanup volunteers requested after event. please follow recycling and composting guides
mira: small ask: be kind to plants and each other. tiny wins stack to big ones. see you at 4pm :sparkles:
